parameters.text:
Analyze the single uploaded image or PDF. It may contain one business card or multiple physically separate business cards placed together. Detect every distinct card and keep each card as a separate contact. Do not merge details from different cards. Return strict JSON only, with no markdown or explanation, using this exact structure:
{
  "detectedCardCount": 0,
  "contacts": [
    {
      "cardNumber": 1,
      "personName": "",
      "companyName": "",
      "email": "",
      "contactNumber": "",
      "jobTitle": "",
      "confidence": "high|medium|low",
      "reviewReasons": []
    }
  ]
}
Rules: create one contact object for each physically separate card; preserve country codes and phone formatting; use empty strings when a field is not visible; never invent names, companies, emails, phone numbers or job titles; do not infer gender or add Mr/Ms unless printed on the card; include a clear reviewReasons entry for blurred, cropped, conflicting or uncertain information; return at most 10 contacts.

parameters.jsCode: const request=$('Authorize CRM Record Mutation').first().json||{};if(request.actionItemsProvided!==true)return[{json:{shouldWrite:'no',_skipActionItemWrite:true}}];const recordId=String(request.recordId||'').trim();const incoming=Array.isArray(request.actionItems)?request.actionItems:[];const existing=items.map(item=>item.json||{}).filter(row=>String(row['Record ID']||'').trim()===recordId&&String(row['Action Item ID']||'').trim());const byId=new Map(existing.map(row=>[String(row['Action Item ID']).trim(),row]));const now=request.lastUpdated||new Date().toISOString();const user=String(request.userEmail||'').trim().toLowerCase();const output=[];const incomingIds=new Set();incoming.forEach((item,index)=>{const id=String(item.actionItemId||`${recordId}-AI-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}-${index+1}`).trim();incomingIds.add(id);const old=byId.get(id)||{};output.push({json:{shouldWrite:'yes',recordId,actionItemId:id,action:String(item.action||'').trim(),owner:String(item.owner||'').trim(),dueDate:String(item.dueDate||'').trim(),status:['Open','In Progress','Completed'].includes(item.status)?item.status:'Open',isActive:item.isActive!==false,createdBy:String(old['Created By']||user),createdAt:String(old['Created At']||now),updatedBy:user,updatedAt:now}});});existing.forEach(old=>{const id=String(old['Action Item ID']||'').trim();const active=!/^(false|0|no)$/i.test(String(old['Is Active']==null?'true':old['Is Active']).trim());if(id&&!incomingIds.has(id)&&active)output.push({json:{shouldWrite:'yes',recordId,actionItemId:id,action:String(old['Action']||'').trim(),owner:String(old['Owner']||'').trim(),dueDate:String(old['Due Date']||'').trim(),status:['Open','In Progress','Completed'].includes(String(old['Status']||''))?String(old['Status']):'Open',isActive:false,createdBy:String(old['Created By']||user),createdAt:String(old['Created At']||now),updatedBy:user,updatedAt:now}});});return output.length?output:[{json:{shouldWrite:'no',_skipActionItemWrite:true}}];
